note: The fixed questions of the notes check, written before any read. Picks and yes-or-no probabilities only; it writes nothing. A yes-or-no is read twice and the less favourable read counts; a pick counts only when both reads choose the same option at or above its bar. The settling rules are in notes_check.py.

step_specific.q: Does `next_step` say what someone will do next on this deal, such as send the pilot scope, send the order form, or call a named person? Yes: it names an action to take; it may also say who or when. Words like "follow up" or "check in" do not make it a placeholder when it also names what will be sent or done. No: it is only a placeholder ("follow up", "check in", "touch base", "TBD", "keep warm") or a status ("waiting on signature", "with their partners"), even when it gives a time.

step_done.q: Does `latest_note` say that the action in `next_step` has already been done, or that it has been called off? A note that only asks for it or plans to do it, or that is about a different action, does not count.

stage_said.q: Do `latest_note` and `earlier_notes` describe at least one event from `stages` that has already happened for this deal, such as a consultation booked or held, a pilot scope sent, a yes to the scope, an order form sent or signed? Answer from the notes alone; `stage` may be wrong.

stage_pick.q: Going only by the notes, which stage has this deal reached? Pick the latest stage whose event the notes say has already happened.

waiting_said.q: Does `latest_note` say what this deal is waiting on before it can move to the next stage?

waiting_pick.q: Going by `latest_note`, what is this deal waiting on now?

stages.Consultation booked: Starts when a consultation with someone at the firm is booked.
stages.Qualified: Starts when the consultation was held with the person who signs. Does not count: a consultation only booked.
stages.Pilot proposed: Starts when a pilot scope (which cases, how many, which work) is sent to the firm. Does not count: a scope only discussed on a call.
stages.Partner said yes: Starts when the owner or managing partner said yes to the pilot scope and price. Does not count: a yes from anyone else.
stages.Order form sent: Starts when the order form is sent for signature. Does not count: an order form only promised.
stages.Won: Starts when the order form has both signatures. Does not count: sent, or signed by one side.
stages.Lost: Starts when the firm said no, or the owner closed it.

waiting.signer: the person who signs has not seen the pilot scope yet
waiting.question: an answer to a question the firm asked, such as price, billing or how the work would run
waiting.order_form: the order form has not been sent yet
waiting.signature: the firm to sign an order form it already has
waiting.quiet: the firm to reply; it has stopped answering
waiting.later_date: a later date the firm asked to come back at
waiting.nothing: nothing; the next meeting or step is already booked
